description.value:
Trigger Someone starts the shuttle engine, or no creatures succeed at their checks to disable the bomb

Effect The bomb explodes. All creatures within 30 feet take @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save.

details.description: An ominous ticking and colorful exposed wires hint at the bomb rigged to the shuttle's cockpit.
details.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:16] to cut the trigger wire, @Check[athletics|dc:18] to rip the bomb out of the console and hurl it away from the craft before it explodes, or a Strike against AC 20 to destroy the ignition source before it sets off the explosive charges

publication.title: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
